verdict.rationale: An engineer can run their own evals before committing: there is a free tier of 10,000 credits per month and a quick-start covering SDKs, CLI and API. On benchmarks, the pack contains no first-party benchmark page, and the only mention of published numbers is a community user who reran the baseline and could not reproduce the team's reported faithfulness figures. Missing for 10: first-party published benchmark methodology and datasets, evidence that the benchmarks are reproducible, and an official eval harness or tooling.
